core_claim: NYC's 311 noise data isn't a map of where the city is loud — it's a map of who picks up the phone (or, increasingly, the app), how the city answers, and what the city actually does with the answer; and within that map, a single Bronx ZIP code (10466) accounts for nearly 9% of every 2024 noise complaint, almost entirely via the mobile app.
tension: Press coverage of 2024 noise said complaints jumped 19%, helicopter noise was 'exploding,' and the city was cracking down. The data says complaints rose 9.8%, helicopter complaints fell by half, residential complaints end with a summons 0.28% of the time, and one ZIP code in the Bronx accounts for nearly a tenth of the citywide signal.
payoff: 311 is a thermometer, not a thermostat. It records intensity faithfully — but who's holding the thermometer matters as much as the temperature, and what the city does with the reading is almost nothing.
